title: On the Spatially Homogeneous Boltzmann Equation with Mass Exchange
summary: We study the spatially homogeneous Boltzmann equation with continuous mass exchange on $X=(0,\infty)_m\times\mathbb R^d_v$, with a Grad cut-off hard-potential collision kernel. For bounded continuous symmetric mass-exchange rates, every nonnegative initial datum with finite number, mass, and kinetic energy admits a global nonnegative $L^1$-integral weak solution in $W^{1,\infty}(0,\infty;L^1(X))$ with number and mass conserved, kinetic energy dissipated.
